versos.grego: Λοιπὸν οὖν, ἀδελφοί, ἐρωτῶμεν ὑμᾶς καὶ παρακαλοῦμεν ἐν Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ, ἵνα καθὼς παρελάβετε παρ’ ἡμῶν τὸ πῶς δεῖ ὑμᾶς περιπατεῖν καὶ ἀρέσκειν Θεῷ, καθὼς καὶ περιπατεῖτε, ἵνα περισσεύητε μᾶλλον.

controles.web: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.
controles.kjv: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.
controles.livre: Portanto, irmãos, no restante, vos rogamos e exortamos no Senhor Jesus, que, assim como recebestes de nós como deveis andar e agradar a Deus , como já estais andando,  que façais assim cada vez mais.

versos.grego: οἴδατε γὰρ τίνας παραγγελίας ἐδώκαμεν ὑμῖν διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
controles.kjv: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
controles.livre: Pois vós sabeis quais mandamentos vos demos pelo Senhor Jesus.

versos.grego: Τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἁγιασμὸς ὑμῶν, ἀπέχεσθαι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς πορνείας,

controles.web: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,
controles.kjv: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:
controles.livre: Pois esta é a vontade de Deus: a vossa santificação, que não pratiqueis pecado sexual;

versos.grego: εἰδέναι ἕκαστον ὑμῶν τὸ ἑαυτοῦ σκεῦος κτᾶσθαι ἐν ἁγιασμῷ καὶ τιμῇ,

controles.web: that each one of you know how to possess himself of his own vessel in sanctification and honor,
controles.kjv: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;
controles.livre: que cada um de vós saiba ser ter o seu instrumento  em santidade e honra;

versos.grego: μὴ ἐν πάθει ἐπιθυμίας καθάπερ καὶ τὰ ἔθνη τὰ μὴ εἰδότα τὸν Θεόν,

controles.web: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God;
controles.kjv: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:
controles.livre: não na paixão do desejo malicioso, como os gentios que não conhecem Deus.

versos.grego: τὸ μὴ ὑπερβαίνειν καὶ πλεονεκτεῖν ἐν τῷ πράγματι τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, διότι ἔκδικος Κύριος περὶ πάντων τούτων, καθὼς καὶ προείπαμεν ὑμῖν καὶ διεμαρτυράμεθα.

controles.web: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.
controles.kjv: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
controles.livre: Ninguém oprima ou engane ao seu irmão nisso, porque o Senhor é vingador de todas essas coisas, como também antes vos dissemos e demos testemunho.

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ ἐκάλεσεν ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς ἐπὶ ἀκαθαρσίᾳ ἀλλ’ ἐν ἁγιασμῷ.

controles.web: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.
controles.kjv: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.
controles.livre: Pois Deus não nos chamou para a impureza, mas sim para a santificação.

versos.grego: τοιγαροῦν ὁ ἀθετῶν οὐκ ἄνθρωπον ἀθετεῖ ἀλλὰ τὸν Θεὸν τὸν καὶ διδόντα τὸ Πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ τὸ ἅγιον εἰς ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.
controles.kjv: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.
controles.livre: Portanto quem rejeita isso , rejeita não ao ser humano, mas sim a Deus, que vos deu também o seu Espírito Santo.

versos.grego: Περὶ δὲ τῆς φιλαδελφίας οὐ χρείαν ἔχετε γράφειν ὑμῖν· αὐτοὶ γὰρ ὑμεῖς θεοδίδακτοί ἐστε εἰς τὸ ἀγαπᾶν ἀλλήλους·

controles.web: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,
controles.kjv: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
controles.livre: Mas quanto ao amor fraternal, não precisais que eu vos escreva, pois vós mesmos estais instruídos por Deus que vos ameis uns aos outros.

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ ποιεῖτε αὐτὸ εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ. Παρακαλοῦμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, περισσεύειν μᾶλλον,

controles.web: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;
controles.kjv: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;
controles.livre: Pois, de fato, já fazeis assim a todos os irmãos de toda a Macedônia. Porém, irmãos, vos exortamos que façaisisso ainda mais.

versos.grego: καὶ φιλοτιμεῖσθαι ἡσυχάζειν καὶ πράσσειν τὰ ἴδια καὶ ἐργάζεσθαι ταῖς χερσὶν ὑμῶν, καθὼς ὑμῖν παρηγγείλαμεν,

controles.web: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you;
controles.kjv: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
controles.livre: E procurai viver quietos, trantando dos vossos próprios assuntos, e trabalhando com as vossas próprias mãos, como já vos mandamos;

versos.grego: ἵνα περιπατῆτε εὐσχημόνως πρὸς τοὺς ἔξω καὶ μηδενὸς χρείαν ἔχητε.

controles.web: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
controles.kjv: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.
controles.livre: para que andeis de maneira respeitosa com os que estão de fora, e não necessiteis de nada.

versos.grego: Οὐ θέλομεν δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν, ἀδελφοί, περὶ τῶν κοιμωμένων, ἵνα μὴ λυπῆσθε καθὼς καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ οἱ μὴ ἔχοντες ἐλπίδα.

controles.web: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.
controles.kjv: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
controles.livre: Mas irmãos, não queremos que desconheçais acerca dos que morreram,  para que não vos entristeçais como os outros que não têm esperança.

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ πιστεύομεν ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἀπέθανεν καὶ ἀνέστη, οὕτως καὶ ὁ Θεὸς τοὺς κοιμηθέντας διὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἄξει σὺν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.
controles.kjv: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
controles.livre: Pois, se cremos que Jesus morreu e ressuscitou, assim também aos que morreram em Jesus, Deus os trará de volta com ele.

versos.grego: Τοῦτο γὰρ ὑμῖν λέγομεν ἐν λόγῳ Κυρίου, ὅτι ἡμεῖς οἱ ζῶντες οἱ περιλειπόμενοι εἰς τὴν παρουσίαν τοῦ Κυρίου οὐ μὴ φθάσωμεν τοὺς κοιμηθέντας·

controles.web: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left to the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.
controles.kjv: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.
controles.livre: Pois dizemos isto pela palavra do Senhor, que nós, os que ficarmos vivos até a vinda do Senhor, não iremos antes dos que morreram.

versos.grego: ὅτι αὐτὸς ὁ Κύριος ἐν κελεύσματι, ἐν φωνῇ ἀρχαγγέλου καὶ ἐν σάλπιγγι Θεοῦ, καταβήσεται ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ οἱ νεκροὶ ἐν Χριστῷ ἀναστήσονται πρῶτον,

controles.web: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,
controles.kjv: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
controles.livre: Pois o mesmo Senhor descerá do céu com grande aclamação, com voz de arcanjo, e com trombeta de Deus; e os que morreram em Cristo ressuscitarão primeiro;

versos.grego: ἔπειτα ἡμεῖς οἱ ζῶντες οἱ περιλειπόμενοι ἅμα σὺν αὐτοῖς ἁρπαγησόμεθα ἐν νεφέλαις εἰς ἀπάντησιν τοῦ Κυρίου εἰς ἀέρα· καὶ οὕτως πάντοτε σὺν Κυρίῳ ἐσόμεθα.

controles.web: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.
controles.kjv: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
controles.livre: Em seguida nós, os que ficarmos vivos, seremos arrebatados juntamente com eles nas nuvens, para encontrar o Senhor no ar, e assim estaremos com o Senhor para sempre.

versos.grego: Ὥστε παρακαλεῖτε ἀλλήλους ἐν τοῖς λόγοις τούτοις.

controles.web: Therefore comfort one another with these words.
controles.kjv: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
controles.livre: Portanto consolai-vos uns aos outros com essas palavras.
